evals.expected_output: Small set of reviewable win theme candidates with rationale, supporting inputs, assumptions, gaps, source refs, and no trusted downstream writes.

evals.prompt: Turn customer hot buttons and seller strengths into value-prop theme candidates for review. No final messaging yet.
